fusions.name: Rebuff
fusions.desc: Shoves outward, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Spare Plank
fusions.desc: Hurls a plank that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Thrown Back
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Glancing Hide
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, you gain a ward that soaks 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
